description: This file manages the rebuilding of the configuration file in the SuiteCRM/Adminstration module. It performs permission checks, handles user requests to rebuild the config, and renders a Smarty template interface for that functionality.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A class used for rendering Smarty templates within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loadCleanConfig
methods.description: Loads a clean copy of the configuration from the config files to be used in rebuilding the config file.

methods.name: rebuildConfigFile
methods.description: Attempts to write a new configuration file based on the provided configuration array and version.
